m.q: Design a flowchart that repeatedly asks for a mark until it is between 0 and 100 inclusive. [5 marks]
st: Start terminator → Input mark parallelogram: receive the mark. [1]
Decision diamond: mark >= 0 AND mark <= 100; label Yes and No paths. [2]
Yes → continue/End; No → return to Input rather than terminate. [1]

k.q: Trace a decision checking whether an IPv4 octet is in the valid numerical range.
k.code:
octet = 260
if octet >= 0 AND octet <= 255 then
    print("Valid range")
else
    print("Out of range")
endif
p: Predict the message and identify the flowchart decision.
Change octet to 255 and predict again.
Explain why an IPv4 octet must be between 0 and 255; note that one valid octet does not validate a complete address.
k.a: 260 produces Out of range; 255 gives Valid range. The decision checks octet >= 0 AND octet <= 255. One IPv4 octet contains eight bits and represents 0–255; a whole IPv4 address contains four octets.
